verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's self-hosted proxy documents virtual keys with spend tracking, per-key and personal budgets (max_budget, budget_duration), and team objects with rpm limits. Every proxy also serves a public OpenAPI/Swagger admin surface, so key and budget provisioning is plausibly API-driven, but the evidence never shows the actual key or budget management endpoints. Gateway and model or MCP provisioning is shown only through config and the UI. missing for 10: explicitly documented admin API endpoints for key generation and budget management, programmatic provisioning of gateways/deployments (MCP servers are added via the UI), and independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven provisioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can provision gateways, keys, and budgets programmatically through an admin API
